title: nutty charred spanish cheese catalan gazpacho
description: charred, cheese-pull brunch-mood spanish dish featuring filo pastry, mother-sauce-base, fodmap-friendly, form=gazpacho, vessel=comal
instructions: preheat comal or large skillet over medium heat.
wrap 2-3 filo pastry sheets around the comal or skillet to create a makeshift grill, leaving some space in between.
brush the filo pastry with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sprinkle with smoked paprika.
once the filo pastry is lightly charred, place the tomatoes, onion, and garlic on top.
drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and season with salt.
cook for 5-7 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
remove the vegetables from the comal or skillet and set aside.
in a blender or food processor, combine the almond milk, cooked vegetables, and cheddar cheese.
blend until smooth and creamy, adding more milk if needed to achieve desired consistency.
serve the gazpacho hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
use the comal or skillet to toast the filo pastry sheets until crispy and golden brown.
